exit=0
--- stdout
WAIT as=Ada timeout=2s interval=1s cursor=-
WAIT OK new=2 after=<elapsed> polls=1
INBOX SCOPE mode=full cursor=- changed=0 carrying=2
INBOX OK as=Ada carrying=2 open=2 notes=1 receipts=1 heard=0 unaddressed=0 unreadable=0
WAIT DONE reason=new rearm=required next=nova-bus wait --bus <bus> --as Ada --receipt-max-words 40 --timeout 2s --interval 1s --remote origin --branch main
--- stderr
